panels.title: Replay clock (IST)
panels.description: Log time of the latest tick the shards applied, in IST: the market's clock, not the wall clock.

panels.title: Margin calls
panels.description: Accounts escalated to MARGIN_CALL so far (since the shard host started).

panels.title: Legs sent
panels.description: Square-off legs the shards planned and published so far.

panels.title: Nifty 50
panels.description: Spot of the latest tick, as the replay plays it.

panels.title: India VIX
panels.description: VIX of the latest tick: the volatility the engine prices with.

panels.title: Margin alerts per second
panels.description: Accounts escalated into each level, per second, across all shards.

panels.title: p99 tick-to-margin (1 min)
panels.description: From a tick being sent to every shard having recomputed every affected account. Target: under 50 ms.

panels.title: Ticks/s (slowest shard)
panels.description: Ticks applied per second by the slowest shard.

panels.title: Shards up
panels.description: 1 while a shard runs; 0 once it stopped on an event it could not apply.

panels.title: Max shard lag
panels.description: Events waiting in the busiest shard's partition.

panels.title: Tick-to-margin latency
panels.description: All shards together, over a sliding minute. The red line is the 50 ms target.

panels.title: p99 per shard
panels.description: A single slow shard shows up here before it moves the overall p99.

panels.title: Ticks applied per second
panels.description: Each tick goes to every shard, so in a healthy system the lines lie on top of each other.

panels.title: Shard lag (events not yet applied)
panels.description: Partition end offset minus the shard's applied offset. Growing = the shard is not keeping up.

panels.title: Events applied per second
panels.description: Ticks plus orders, fills, closes and risk-ops events.

panels.title: JVM: GC time and heap
panels.description: Read latency spikes against this before tuning anything else.
